audit_scope.repository: web-iot frontend Git checkout plus read-only sibling firmware under smart-pet-feeder/esp-code
audit_scope.note: The localhost fake-CAM test verifies Vite proxy behavior only. No actual CAM or WROOM endpoint is marked hardware verified.

endpoints.purpose: CAM link/RSSI plus compact telemetry status
endpoints.test_evidence: Static source scan; CAM only changes latestTelemetryJson if it receives <TELEM:...>. WROOM emits no TELEM frame. CAM therefore serves its synthetic initial telemetry indefinitely in the current source pair.

endpoints.authentication: X-API-Key required by CAM; Vite development proxy now injects server-side

frontend.parsing: 202 accepted response; operation outcome expected from events

endpoints.test_evidence: Local fake-CAM proxy test passed method/body/key forwarding. Static source scan finds CAM sends FEED_NOW and FEED, but WROOM handles only FEED_NOW. WROOM does not acknowledge command IDs; actual actuator result is untested.

endpoints.purpose: Abort current feed and close gate
endpoints.test_evidence: CAM writes ABORT and returns 202. WROOM command parser has no ABORT branch; no gate-close action or result acknowledgement is connected to this route.
CAM writes CLEAR and returns 202. WROOM does not handle CLEAR. Web toast was changed to accepted/unconfirmed wording; no device fault-clear event exists.

frontend.parsing: scheduleFromRaw; errors are swallowed into disabled defaults

endpoints.test_evidence: CAM serves in-memory scheduleJson. WROOM clockService explicitly leaves schedule matching unimplemented and has no persisted schedule storage.
CAM copies raw body into RAM and sends SCHED JSON. WROOM has no SCHED handler; invalid/missing fields and chunk boundaries are not validated. 202 plus GET echo is not WROOM persistence proof.

frontend.parsing: eventFromLog; errors are swallowed into empty array

endpoints.test_evidence: logBufferJson is initialized to [] and never updated. The CAM converts WROOM's amount-only LOG frame into a fabricated record for SSE; the WROOM supplies no source, target, weights, result, duration, or request ID.

frontend.parsing: Blob to object URL; does not check image content type

endpoints.test_evidence: Source path and MIME agree. Camera hardware and response bytes were unavailable. CAM returns the framebuffer to the camera immediately after scheduling the asynchronous response; buffer lifetime needs validation against the actual AsyncWebServer library.
CAM writes TARE and returns 202. WROOM has no TARE handler. Web toast now says accepted/unconfirmed and no longer records a successful tare timestamp.

request_schema.known_g: number; frontend sends entered mass; CAM defaults to 200 on parse/missing field

endpoints.test_evidence: CAM ignores JSON parse errors, uses 200 fallback, sends CAL; WROOM has no CAL handler. The CAM reports a fixed factor without an acknowledgement from the scale. Web no longer stores the returned factor as verified calibration.

frontend.parsing: CommandAck; hardware config is cached in localStorage

endpoints.test_evidence: CAM forwards raw CFG JSON. WROOM has no CFG handler, so current code does not apply settings. Frontend cache is not firmware persistence evidence.

endpoints.purpose: Live telemetry, status, logs, pet, low-food, and error events

frontend.parsing: JSON parse guarded; browser EventSource reconnects automatically

endpoints.test_evidence: Proxy framing/content-type smoke test passed with fake localhost CAM. CAM source does not produce status/error events. WROOM emits no telemetry frame; real SSE connectivity and reconnect behavior not tested.

headers.cors: Access-Control-Allow-Origin *; methods GET,POST,PUT,OPTIONS; allowed headers Content-Type,X-API-Key,Accept

frontend.file: Vite proxy is same-origin from browser

endpoints.test_evidence: Source only; no CAM HTTP server ran.

uart_contracts.name: Heartbeat CAM-to-WROOM
uart_contracts.receiver_handler: WROOM commService recognizes msg prefix HB:
uart_contracts.response: No explicit ack; WROOM marks isLinked

uart_contracts.name: Heartbeat WROOM-to-CAM
uart_contracts.receiver_handler: CAM accepts startsWith <HB and ending >, replies <HB:OK>\n

uart_contracts.name: Manual feed
uart_contracts.receiver_handler: Only FEED_NOW:g is parsed; FEED:g is ignored
uart_contracts.outcome: State machine may enter PRECHECK only while IDLE; no command ACK or correlation ID

uart_contracts.name: Schedule update
uart_contracts.receiver_handler: None; WROOM schedule service is a TODO

uart_contracts.name: Telemetry
uart_contracts.receiver_handler: CAM parser exists; WROOM producer is missing

uart_contracts.name: Feed log
uart_contracts.receiver_handler: CAM parses a float and fabricates other fields; /api/log buffer remains empty

uart_contracts.name: Low hopper
uart_contracts.receiver_handler: CAM emits low_food {pct:12}; repeated below-threshold readings can repeat alerts

uart_contracts.name: Pet detection/verdict
uart_contracts.receiver_handler: WROOM accepts verdict only while ST_WAIT_PET; CAM labels IR trigger as pet with fixed confidence

uart_contracts.name: Checksum/framing
uart_contracts.frame: Angle-bracket text with newline delimiter; no checksum, length cap, or request ID
